question: Which mantra string is identified here as belonging to the deity named Mṛtyuñjit?
premises: The string om juṃsaḥ is given with iti.
inference: The mantra om juṃsaḥ is declared as this mantra of the deity called Mṛtyuñjit.
uncertainties: Exact pronunciation/segmentation of juṃsaḥ is kept as surface.
plain_english: Om, juṃsaḥ—thus (is) this mantra; the deity is named Mṛtyuñjit.
